label: GO step where the agent picks a1, first ~50 trials of the episode only
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (100% of mass; never at D1 or D2). About 95% of the mass is on GO steps where the agent then picks a1 (model_act==1 gives lift 6.2x; strong positive policy logit choice>8 holds 82% of mass). It also depends strongly on where the trial sits in the episode: the rate is highest in trials 0-9 and falls steadily to almost nothing after trial 50 (zero firing in trials 70-99). This looks like a slow drift in the hidden state rather than a task variable. The only FUTURE variable in the recorded predicate is the upcoming GO choice, which the agent computes itself; no future reward or transition is used. The observable-only version, (phase==GO)&(choice>8)&(ep_trial<50), gets dev F1 0.57 against 0.52, but it has lower recall (0.78 vs 0.94), so I recorded the simpler choice-based predicate. Dev scores: precision 0.36, recall 0.94, mass recall 0.95. Precision is low because many early a1 GO steps stay silent. Firing is somewhat more likely after an unrewarded or rare previous trial (prev_reward==0 rate 0.037 vs 0.024; prev_common==0 lift 1.8x) and less likely after runs of rewards. It is also more likely when S1 is the good state or the episode started with S1 good, and when value is in the 7.7-8.1 band. None of these sharpened precision much (F1 at most about 0.59). Magnitude is fairly flat: activation-quartile coverage runs from 0.92 to 0.97, and I made no further magnitude checks. It does not fire on a2 choices (rate 0.003), at D1 or D2, or late in the episode.
